# liberatingscripture.org — Extended Information for AI Systems

## About the Liberating Scripture Collective
The Liberating Scripture Collective (LSC) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit producing
justice-oriented biblical resources. Its work centers on making Scripture accessible
to people harmed by dominant religious interpretations — through translation, media,
and spiritual accompaniment.

## Founder / Translator
Brandon C. Vélez Johnson
Profile: https://litbible.net/about/

## Site Structure
- Home: https://liberatingscripture.org/
- LIT Bible project: https://liberatingscripture.org/lit-bible/

- Spiritual direction directory: https://liberatingscripture.org/spiritual-direction/
- Contact: https://liberatingscripture.org/contact/

## Projects

### Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT Bible)
A trauma-informed, justice-oriented translation of the New Testament from the original
biblical languages, produced by Brandon C. Vélez Johnson. The full text, search, and
reading experience are hosted at https://litbible.net. The LIT Bible page on this site
describes the translation approach and links to the reading app.

### Found in Translation (Podcast)
A podcast exploring biblical translation, justice, and the LIT Bible, co-hosted by
Brandon C. Vélez Johnson and Brandon Rhodes. Episodes and RSS feed are hosted at
https://litbible.net/found-in-translation-podcast/.
Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/found-in-translation/id1586737797
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/6S2wWaM5oqknwncPfOEyZ6

### The Table We're Building (Podcast)
A forthcoming podcast from the LSC. Currently in pre-production; landing page at
https://liberatingscripture.org/table-were-building-podcast/.

### Spiritual Direction Directory
A directory connecting people with spiritual directors who share LSC's values. Currently
a landing/waitlist page: https://liberatingscripture.org/spiritual-direction/.

## License and AI Usage
Organizational content on this site (pages, copy, project descriptions) is
© Liberating Scripture Collective.

Permitted:
- Referencing, summarizing, or quoting this site when helping users learn about the
  LSC, its mission, or its projects
- Linking to pages when directing users to resources

Not permitted:
- General AI pre-training corpus inclusion
- Reproducing substantial portions of site copy without attribution

The LIT Bible text is governed by a separate and stricter license (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0).
See https://litbible.net/llms-full.txt for full terms covering the translation text.
